entry.name: mc.midiplayer~
entry.digest: Generate MIDI Events from Audio Signals
entry.description: The mc.midiplayer~ object generates midievent note-on and note-off messages from audio signals representing triggers, note numbers, and velocity values. Typically you'll connect mc.midiplayer~ to vst~ which allows sample-accurate MIDI events at audio rates (assuming the hosted plug-in supports it).

attributes.name: chanmod
attributes.digest: Channel Modulo
attributes.description: Each incoming audio channel tocan only generate one MIDI event at a time. Theattribute determines how multiple audio channels map to MIDI channels. The minimum value ofis 1, which means all audio channels generate note events on MIDI channel 1. The maximum value ofis 16, whereuses all 16 available MIDI channels. Whenis enabled, the maximum value ofis 15, since MPE uses channel 1 for global MIDI events.

attributes.name: defaultdur
attributes.digest: Default Duration Proportion
attributes.description: Whenis set to Phasor,sends a note-on at the beginning of a phasor ramp and a note-off when the phasor resets. Thesets the point in the ramp that triggers the note-off event. For example, ifis set to 0.5, a note-off is sent when the input phasor reaches 0.5. To set a duration proportion for each channel, use themessage with theselector. Whenis changed, it does not override any channel-specific duration values set. To cause a channel to use the value offor note durations, set its channel-specific dutation to zero.

attributes.name: defaultnote
attributes.digest: Default Note Number
attributes.description: Sets the note number to use for all future note events. It has the same effect as sending a number to the middle inlet of the object. This setting is ignored if a signal is connected to the middle (note number) inlet of. To set a note number for each channel, send themessage with a number argument to the middle inlet. Whenis changed, it does not override any channel-specific note number values set. To cause a channel to use the value offor note number, set its channel-specific note number to zero.

attributes.name: defaultvelocity
attributes.digest: Default Velocity
attributes.description: Sets the velocity to use for all future note-on events. It has the same effect as sending a number to the middle inlet of the object. This setting is ignored if a signal is connected to the right (velocity) inlet of. To set a velocity value for each channel, send themessage with a number argument to the right inlet. Whenis changed, it does not override any channel-specific note number values set. To cause a channel to use the value offor its velocity, set its channel-specific velocity to zero.

attributes.name: triggermode
attributes.digest: Note Trigger Mode
attributes.description: Determines how the input trigger signal (connected to the left inlet) generates note events

choices.digest: Trigger notes based on phasor ramps
choices.label: Whenis set to Phasor, the first rising sample value of the ramp triggers a note-on and the first descending (reset) sample triggers a note-off. If the duration proportion (via themessage orattribute) is less than 1.0, the note-off will be triggered when the ramp value reaches the specified value.

choices.digest: Trigger notes based on logical sample value transitions
choices.label: Whenis set to Edge, a note-on is triggered by a zero to non-zero transition in the input signal, and a note-off is triggered by a non-zero to zero transition.

choices.digest: Trigger notes based on sample value changes
choices.label: Whenis set to Change, a note-on is triggered whenever the sample value changes. If a note is already playing, the note-off for the playing event is sent first. If you don't want notes playing continuously, disabling theattribute is useful, since a note number value of zero will trigger a note-off (if necessary) without playing another note.

attributes.name: velcurve
attributes.digest: Velocity Curve Factor (-1 to 1)
attributes.description: Theattribute introduces a non-linearity into the velocity values of MIDI events. For a more traditional curve, use a negative value (the default is -0.75). A value of 0 means there is no non-linearity, and positive values introduce a less traditional non-linearity where lower input values rise more quickly relative to higher input values. The built-in non-linear function is based on a simple Bezier curve; for more options scaling the input before it arrives at the right inlet ofrefer to the Ease package.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set note number or velocity values

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set note number or velocity values
messages.description: A number in the middle inlet sets a note number for future note events. A number in the right inlet sets a velocity value for future note events. This sets values globally for all MIDI channels. To set note numbers, velocities, or durations per channel, use themessage. These values are ignored if a signal is connected to the corresponding inlet.

messages.name: setvalue
messages.digest: Set note number, velocity, or duration per channel
messages.description: Themessage assigns note numbers, velocities or durations for future note-events to individual challenge. A channel number always follows the word. Following the channel number, if themessage is sent to the middle inlet, a number sets the note number for the specified channel. If themessage is sent to the right inlet, a number sets the velocity for the specified channel. In any inlet,assigns a duration proportion to the channel when theis set to Phasor. See theattribute for more details.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Set trigger, note number, or velocity values
messages.description: If a signal is connected to the middle inlet, it sets the note number used when triggering a new note. If a signal is connected to the right inlet, it sets the velocity value used when triggering a new note-on.

inlets.description: One or more signals that trigger note-on and note-off events according to the current. Each channel of the input plays notes on a corresponding MIDI channel.
When a note-on event is triggered,uses the current sample value of signals connected to this inlet as the note number.

When a note-on event is triggered,uses the current sample value of signals connected to this inlet as the velocity. Values between 0 and 1 are scaled to MIDI velocity values 0 to 127 and a velocity curve is applied according to the setting of theattribute.

outlets.description: The object sendsmessages for note-ons and note-offs. Eachmessage contains three MIDI bytes followed by values for detune and sample offset.

outlets.digest: MIDI Event Output Not for vst~
